summary: Tested PDP coupon toggle + price reflection, trust badges + cert strip (desktop 1920 and mobile 390), PDP->Cart coupon carry-over, admin bulk-AI generate backend flow, cart combo progress banner, and smoke of /, /shop, /product. 5 of 6 scenarios PASS. Found one real integration bug: GLOW15 coupon claimed on PDP does NOT auto-apply on /cart — the cart total stays ₹999 instead of ₹849.

integration_issues.issue: ProductDetailPage.js writes localStorage.setItem('discountClaimed','GLOW15') (lines 299, 307), but CartPage.js (line 221) checks localStorage.getItem('discountClaimed') === 'true' AND reads the code from a separate 'discountCode' key (line 222) that PDP never sets. So the auto-apply useEffect bails out (claimed=false, claimedCode='') and the cart never calls applyCouponCode('GLOW15'). Cart Total stays ₹999 (verified in UI) instead of ₹849. Note: the 'GLOW15' string shown in the cart body text comes from the Available Offers list, not from an applied discount.

action_items: Fix PDP→Cart coupon handoff: either (a) in ProductDetailPage.js set localStorage.setItem('discountClaimed','true') AND localStorage.setItem('discountCode','GLOW15'); or (b) in CartPage.js change the check to accept the current PDP format — e.g. const raw = localStorage.getItem('discountClaimed'); const claimedCode = (raw && raw !== 'true' && raw !== 'false') ? raw.toUpperCase() : (localStorage.getItem('discountCode')||'').toUpperCase(); const claimed = !!claimedCode;
After fixing, also dispatch the 'discountClaimed' CustomEvent from PDP so the cart listener (CartPage.js lines 232-250) picks it up when the cart tab is already open.
critical_code_review_comments: localStorage key contract mismatch between ProductDetailPage.js and CartPage.js — two components reading/writing the same keys with incompatible semantics. Suggest extracting a tiny claimedCoupon.js helper (getClaimedCoupon()/setClaimedCoupon(code)/clearClaimedCoupon()) and importing from both pages.
CartPage.js is 896 lines — consider splitting the coupon/gift-card block and the recommendations/combo blocks into subcomponents.
Minor React warning in PDP console: 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority (did you mean fetchPriority)' — attribute casing on an / tag.
